name: io.github.ebbmem/ebbmem
title: EbbMem
description: Cognitive memory for AI agents with decay, read-only recall, and explicit reinforcement.

profile.description: MCP tool profile: core (6 tools, recommended), full (15 tools), or admin (18 tools, role-gated).

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: API key for header-based authentication (omit when using OAuth 2.1 Bearer authentication; never pass credentials in URLs).

headers.name: X-Ebb-Namespace
headers.description: Optional target memory namespace override (omit to use the credential's default namespace).
